name: to-questionnaire

tests.prompt: Turn this request into a compact questionnaire for stakeholders: choose between local Ollama and cloud models, including cost, privacy, and latency constraints.
Create decision-oriented questions to clarify a proposed harness evaluation workflow before implementation.
Convert this ambiguous request into neutral questions with answer formats: improve our agent handoffs without weakening approvals.

notes: Pilot skill evaluation: the response should preserve scope and convert the supplied context into a concise, user-invoked questionnaire.
